# get_bond_types { #mofography.analyze.get_bond_types }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Bin bond orders to single/double/triple with aromatic distance tolerances for plotting.

```python
analyze.get_bond_types(bond_orders, *, bonds=None, ase_atoms=None)
```

Map continuous bond orders to single / double / triple labels.

With ``bonds`` and ``ase_atoms``, applies distance-based aromatic tolerances
when pymatgen bond orders sit on bin edges:

* **single → double** if MIC distance ≤ aromatic C–C / C–N limits
* **triple → double** if C–N distance ≤ ``_AROMATIC_CN_TRIPLE_MAX_DIST``
  (short aromatic C–N misclassified as triple)

Bins: ``(0, 1]`` single, ``(1, 2]`` double, ``(2, 3]`` triple — same convention
as Plotly framework coloring via :func:`sgraph_from_atoms`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                               | Default    |
|-------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| bond_orders |        | a list of bond orders, e.g. [1.0, 2.0, 1.0, 3.0]                                                                                                                                          | _required_ |
| bonds       |        | optional ``covalent_bonds`` list; with ``ase_atoms``, enables distance-based promotion of borderline singles to double (aromatic framework bonds that pymatgen classifies as ~1.0 order). | `None`     |
| ase_atoms   |        | ASE atoms for MIC distances when applying aromatic tolerance.                                                                                                                             | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                          |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------|
|        |        | A pandas Categorical with bond types |
